{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk slip dress, fluid straight cut, midi length reaching mid-calf, ivory color (#FFFFF0), heavy crepe de Chine.
Textured wool-blend blazer, tailored single-breasted cut with notched lapels, hip length, charcoal heather gray (#36454F), fine bouclé fabric.
Pointed-toe pumps, sleek silhouette, ankle height, classic black (#000000), smooth calfskin leather.
Pearl drop earrings and a delicate gold chain necklace as accessories, medium-light shimmer finish, 18k white gold plating.

This outfit works perfectly for an August evening wedding transitioning from an outdoor ceremony to a restaurant reception by balancing elegance with practicality. The ivory silk slip dress provides a romantic and noble base suitable for formal summer attire, while the charcoal wool blazer adds structure and sophistication required for the "formal" dress code specified. Choosing dark shoes anchors the lightness of the fabric under artificial evening lighting, ensuring the ensemble remains refined yet comfortable enough to move between grass and dining tables."}
